title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and translation vector also set to zero. In the first face, draw a circle with the center at [0.0082, 0.0082] and a radius of 0.0082. In the second face, draw another circle with the center at [0.0082, 0.1007] and the same radius of 0.0082. Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.1089. Since no additional transformation is required, proceed to extrude the scaled sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units. Ensure that the extrusion does not extend in the opposite direction. Finally, create a new solid body from this extrusion. The final dimensions of the part are a length of 0.016438356164383564 units, a width of 0.10890410958904112 units, and a height of 0.7500000000000001 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.0082, 0.0082).circle(0.0082)

# Add the second circle to the sketch
sketch = sketch.center(0, 0.0925).circle(0.0082)

# Extrude the sketch to create the 3D object
extrusion = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = extrusion

import cadquery as cq

# Create the first part
part_1 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.0082, 0.0082)
    .circle(0.0082)
    .extrude(0.75)
)

# Create the second part
part_2 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.0082, 0.1007)
    .circle(0.0082)
    .extrude(0.75)
)

# Combine the parts
r = part_1.union(part_2)

lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Two parallel cylindrical rods along Z
rod_radius = 0.0082
rod_height = 0.75

# First rod
rod1 = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.0082, 0.0082).circle(rod_radius).extrude(rod_height)

# Second rod, offset in Y
rod2 = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.0082, 0.1089 - 0.0082).circle(rod_radius).extrude(rod_height)

# Union the two rods into a single part
r = rod1.union(rod2)

import cadquery as cq

# Two parallel rods, same diameter (0.0164), both length 0.75,
# separated in Y so the bounding box is 0.1089 in Y
d = 0.0164
r1 = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.0082, 0.0082).circle(d / 2).extrude(0.75)
r2 = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.0082, 0.1089 - 0.0082).circle(d / 2).extrude(0.75)

r = r1.union(r2)
